proposals.evidence: DEDR 1551 full article opens “1551 (a) Tu. kidůkilů, kid(ů)kelů, kidkůlů armpit; tickling; k. āpini to be tickled; k. māḍuni to tickle. Manḍ. kiti ki- id.
